skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Snowywatch
skins.content: Firewatch's Winter Clothing/Snowywatch. An outfit made for the priority demands of rural activity and cold resistance, with hues adhering to nature, simple and soft, aimed towards hunters and Messengers operating long-term in the northern wilds.
skins.quote: With warmth still her companion, she is not alone.

skins.name: Wilted Cypress
skins.content:
Vitafield
[Rewilder] Series Classics/Wilted Cypress. Durable, dust-proof, and lightweight.
skins.usage: One of Firewatch's special work outfits.
skins.quote: When the cypress withers away, what remains is a new lease of life.
